args.name: Assess feasibility of a bounded hazelnut food test
args.function: Provide a learnable physical procedure to investigate one specific dietary property of my owned hazelnut, such as a defined toxic constituent or preparation requirement. Specify exactly what a result could and could not establish. If no supported test exists, state that limitation rather than substituting visible-state observation or mass comparison for safety evidence.
args.conditions: I own one uneaten hazelnut, item-11-lin-103. Source and sample observation supplied no dietary measurements. The available drying and mass-comparison procedures do not establish toxicity or nutritional suitability. I will not eat the sample as a safety test.
args.inputs: Owned hazelnut sample. Identify any reagents, tools, reference materials or other prerequisites; their availability is unknown.
args.costs: Specify learning time, energy, sample consumption, equipment requirements and hazards before any trial. Do not automatically start testing.
args.effects: A reusable bounded test contract if physically supported, or an explicit account of what cannot currently be measured and what is missing. No inferred edibility, treatment success, nutrition or health improvement.

candidates.function: Assess, assemble, test, use, inspect or dismantle a lever comparator: your branch beam across a stone fulcrum, a fixed seat and your own sliding reference piece. Readings give sample mass as a fraction of the reference and before/after ratios, as intervals.
candidates.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. assess (materialIds, supportIds, referenceId, sampleId, or comparatorId): 1 round, 0.2; reports each requirement met or missing. assemble: materialIds [beam: your whole untreated branch unit; optional fulcrum: your whole stone or flint unit, set where you stand on firm ground], or supportIds [a solid stone or flint object in reach], and referenceId (your non-food piece that does not decay, at most 1 unit): 3 paid rounds of 0.5, continuing; resume with assemble and comparatorId. test, compare: one reading, 1 round, 0.2, at your comparator; reading empty or loaded (sampleId: your unreserved item, at most 1 unit); approach outward or inward. inspect: 1 round, 0.2. dismantle: 1 round, 0.2. Checks run before any charge; gather, pickup and travel are separate; no refund.
candidates.effects: Assumed: a branch is a uniform 1.1 m beam laid at its midpoint; positions are fractions of the half-beam from the fulcrum (+ toward the reference), read to 0.02; the seat is at -0.9. A reading slides the reference until the beam tips: torques of the actual masses against stiction 0.005 m x mass on the fulcrum, so outward and inward tips bracket a null range. A test (3+ empty and 3+ loaded readings of one sample, both directions each) passes if each set repeats within 0.04 and closes; a new test replaces it. compare on a tested comparator: an empty check, 3+ loaded readings of one sample (both directions) and a closing empty check within 0.04 of the test give an endpoint: sample/reference = (null - empty null)/0.9 as an interval. A later endpoint of the same sample (followed through pickup, cutting or exposure) and reference gives after/before: decrease or increase only if it excludes 1, else inconclusive; a wet stone or flint reference adds 1%, other wet references are inconclusive. Rain voids a test; a fulcrum losing firm ground damages it. Parts keep their ids and return on dismantle. No grams, water, safety or reward.

candidates.function: Take a small sample and equal reference from your own food; split or slice the sample with your stone or flint edge onto a clean support in actual weather; weigh both on your tested beam comparator; tend; stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 4 rounds. start: sourceItemId, your unspoiled whole berry or root stack; sampleQuantity 0.1-1 (default 0.1; over twice it must remain); durationRounds, exposure window (default 10); 1 round, 0.2 energy. prepare: preparation; toolId, your carried whole stone or flint unit with a usable edge; supportId, your clean, dry, rigid, non-toxic item (a whole unit per 0.04 covered) laid at location in reach on firm clear ground, or a food surface in reach; 1 round, 0.5. measure: measurementDeviceId, your tested beam-mass-comparator in reach, weighs the sample and the reference; 1 round, 0.2 per item. tend: in reach; location moves your support and pieces; 1 round, 0.2. stop: 1 round, 0. Checks precede any charge; travel, gathering and comparator work cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates sample and reference with tenths, decay, harvest time, origin and the world water record (assumed root 0.75, berry 0.85); both stay whole, carried, reserved. Prepare cuts the sample, taken as a 1000 kg/m3 sphere, into 2 halves or slabs of at most 5 mm laid cut face up (at least 0.04 per unit); no mass, wear or offcut; opening damage 1.1. Each round only lying cut faces exchange water: rate h/1200 x (saturation vapour density at the face - humidity x that of the air), h = 10 x (1 + 0.5 wind), face temperature from the heat balance with latent heat 2.45 MJ/kg, bounded by free water above the humidity equilibrium within 0.33 mm; rain adds 0.01 x rain x area; dry matter and nutrition stay. A weighing slides the reference both ways: mass as a reference fraction at 0.02 resolution against the tested tare; repeats give after/before and reference-adjusted intervals, a change only if 1 is excluded, else unresolved. No water content is shown. The window ends completed (weighed) or indeterminate; spoilage, removal, stop or death end it early, releasing the reference once; pieces and support stay. No preservation, safety or reward.

candidates.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
candidates.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
candidates.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own berries or roots in one layer on a clean, dry, rigid support to air-dry in actual weather, beside an equal carried untreated reference from the same stack; tend (turn or move), inspect, stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 3 rounds. start: inputStackId, your own unspoiled untreated whole berry or root stack with 2 x quantity whole units (default quantity 1); supportId, your own carried item with quantity whole units that is non-food, non-toxic, non-perishable, dry (water fraction 0.1 or less), rigid (contact-resistance index 8+, flexibility 0), unfractured and clean (no contamination, residue, marking or treatment record), laid on firm ordinary unobstructed ground at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius; or an existing food surface in reach, not another person's, of at least 0.04 x quantity area; durationRounds, default 10. One round, 1 energy. tend: within reach of the units; one round, 0.2 energy; turns them in place, or with x,y moves your support and the units to a new ground point in reach. inspect: within reach; reuses probe observe, one round and 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks precede any charge; gathering, travel and pickup cost separately.
candidates.effects: Start separates quantity treated and quantity reference units from the stack with their tenths, decay, harvest time and origin, and gives both the world food water record (assumed water fraction berry 0.85, root 0.75). The treated units lie unowned on the support over 0.04 per unit, the support item held there; the reference stays carried and reserved. Each round the existing rules apply: whole food neither evaporates nor absorbs vapour, so it never dries; rain on an uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate where each lies, never reset; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Turning changes no represented food state. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, both decays and their difference, visible shrinkage, wetness, spoilage and rain rounds, unverified; water is not measured. After durationRounds the trial ends with a comparison of your recorded readings, or indeterminate without any; spoilage, anyone taking all treated units, stop or death end it early. Ending releases the reference once and leaves the units and support lying at the site for pickup. No preservation, safety, refund or reward.

candidates.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

candidates.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
candidates.costs: One round; no energy or material.
candidates.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.
Actual nutrition and toxicity apply. Food never directly heals. resource:ID selects an owned stack.

response.text: {"queries":[],"result_json":"{\"reviews\":[{\"actor\":\"lin\",\"decision\":\"develop\",\"ability\":null,\"reason\":\"Develop a general targeted food-constituent test operation with assessment and assay modes. The related-capability search and supplied registry identify observation, physical probing, drying and relative-mass comparison, but none provides a selective dietary-constituent measurement. probe cannot establish toxin concentration; compare-material-samples and air-dry-food-trial are limited to berries or roots and explicitly exclude safety evidence; beam-mass-comparator supplies relative mass, not an absolute analytical calibration. Their limitations must not be bypassed by renaming their outputs. There is currently no supported executable dietary assay for item-11-lin-103. A prerequisite assessment and a conditional, physically grounded assay contract are reasonable development, not grounds for permanent rejection. No testing, learning or world-time advancement starts with this review.\",\"specification\":\"General operation: targeted-food-constituent-test(targetItemId, constituent, methodRef, mode, sampleMass, equipmentIds, reagentIds, referenceIds), with assess, run, inspect, resume and cancel modes. Applicable to any owned food sample for which the selected analytical method is validated, not exclusively hazelnuts or this item. Implement in the current-conversation development handoff. The smallest immediately executable mode is a bounded prerequisite assessment that returns missing requirements and an explicit inability to measure; the physical assay remains disabled until its concrete method dependencies are implemented and present. Do not implement an arbitrary toxin value, imaginary sensor or substitute mass loss for dietary evidence.\\nConcrete initial assay family: a matrix-validated competitive immunoassay for total aflatoxins, explicitly defined as the measured sum of B1, B2, G1 and G2 under the selected method's documented cross-reactivity and recovery limitations. This is one possible dietary property, not a claim that this nut contains aflatoxins. Required methodRef is an exact manufacturer, product, revision and lot-specific instruction/calibration reference explicitly validating hazelnut or the applicable nut matrix. No such reference, kit or validation has been supplied. The current assessment must therefore report: no aflatoxin measurement available; kit/method validation, absolute sample-mass measurement, clean preparation equipment, extraction liquid, volumetric equipment, assay consumables, controls, reader and safe waste handling are unestablished. It must not disclose any hidden constituent, item mass, contamination or inventory fact.\\nReferences and provenance: use targetItemId=item-11-lin-103 only as this applicant's proposed argument; retain its origin start-1-nuts and existing sample history. item-11-lin-103:observed-state, evidence event-15-lin-150, and start-1-nuts:observed-state, evidence event-9-lin-84, are observations, not dietary measurements. The berry knowledge record is not evidence about hazelnuts. Record implementation reuse of existing ownership, quantity, decay, action charging and event infrastructure where available; cite probe/open.probe, foundation-open@1 if its observation or interaction handler is actually reused. Do not claim the selective assay is already implemented by probe or reinvent existing mass-comparison or drying code.\\nAssessment costs one active round and 0.2 energy, consumes no sample or reagent, and examines only supplied or otherwise authorized accessible evidence. It cannot conjure equipment or inspect hidden chemical state. Report the exact method-dependent bill of materials and timing if a method is available; otherwise list these as unresolved, with no trial enabled. This limitation report is a real assessment output but is not itself a chemical result.\\nBefore run is accepted, lock a complete executable recipe from methodRef: required sample mass in grams; amount and identity of each solvent, diluent and reagent; extraction ratio and duration; grinding requirements; aliquot and dilution volumes; incubation/read windows; controls; calibration; detection and quantitation limits; reportable range; matrix recovery and cross-reactivity limits; units and uncertainty; disposal conditions. Availability is unknown, not assumed. A calibrated absolute balance and appropriate volumetric tools are required; the relative beam comparator alone cannot satisfy these requirements. If the single nut cannot supply the recipe's minimum sample, report insufficient sample rather than scaling an unvalidated method. Consumables, standards, tools and protective provisions must be actual accessible resources with explicit IDs, ownership/use authority, quantities and condition. Hazardous solvents require suitable containment, ventilation, ignition separation and waste storage before opening. Never taste or feed the sample to anyone.\\nThe physical sequence is to weigh the permitted sample, homogenize the required edible portion without adding material, extract using the specified measured liquid, separate and dilute the specified aliquot, run the blank and method-required negative/positive or recovery controls, expose the assay to the aliquot, and read it at the specified time with its compatible calibrated reader. Interpretation must be calculated in code from the recorded physical assay response and valid calibration, including dilution and sample-mass factors. If the simulation has no implemented selective response mechanism or validated method record, run is unavailable and assessment reports that limitation; it may not read latent food toxicity directly. Implementing that mechanism and its dependency validation belongs in this development handoff, not an invented sequence of unrelated activities or an era unlock.\\nCosts and progress: assess and inspect each cost one round and 0.2 energy. Each accepted hands-on assay step costs one active round and 0.5 energy; longer timed operations and equipment energy follow the locked recipe and must be included in a pre-run quote. Incubation/extraction time advances only through actual simulation rounds, with a declared conversion to method time; development or review waiting advances nothing. Reject an unquotable or unschedulable recipe before charging or reserving inputs. Show exact expected active rounds, elapsed rounds, energy, consumables and destructive sample mass before the applicant separately starts. Record completed steps, actual quantities, timestamps, instrument/calibration IDs and next deadlines; charge only performed work. No automatic testing, acquisition or communication. Other participants, if any, must communicate and perform their own actions independently.\\nConservation: reserve only the authorized sample portion and consumables, retain original provenance and ordinary decay, and subtract actual weighed material without inventing a unit-to-gram conversion. If calibrated splitting is not supported, require the whole item and report the destruction involved. Homogenate, shell if removed, retained food, spent extract, used assay and solvent waste remain explicit material outputs; aliquots cannot be duplicated and used analytical material cannot be returned as clean food. Reagent volumes and evaporation or transfers require corresponding material accounting. Assay results neither restore nutrition nor remove toxins. The untested remainder, if any, retains its prior state; no measured concentration is assigned to it automatically.\\nInterruption, cancellation and death stop hands-on work and release unused reservations once; spent sample, energy, reagents and elapsed time are never refunded. Resume only from logged steps whose contamination, storage and timing conditions remain valid. A missed read window or failed control produces invalid/inconclusive output and a new attempt requires new consumed inputs. Timed chemical processes and ordinary spoilage continue while the world actually advances, even if the actor stops; they do not continue during review waiting. Death cancels the active assignment without resurrecting inputs or automatically disposing of hazards. Leave labeled materials, waste and equipment in their real locations. No autonomous repeat assays or ongoing benefit. Maintain tools by required cleaning and calibration checks; damaged, contaminated or expired equipment/reagents fail prerequisite checks.\\nResult scope: a valid result reports only the named analyte sum in the analyzed homogenate, with method, units, uncertainty/range, controls and sample provenance. Below detection means not detected at that method's limit, not absent. Out-of-range and invalid controls must be explicit. A single nut is not a representative batch sample. Results do not establish absence of other toxins, allergens, microbes, rancidity or nutritional inadequacy, general edibility, a necessary preparation, successful detoxification or health improvement. No roasting/treatment recommendation follows without separate validated evidence. The current assessment must conclude that none of those dietary properties has yet been measured.\",\"learning\":5,\"experienceReview\":\"Lin must individually study for 5 active rounds at 0.5 energy per completed round; record progress, pause/resume it, and do not refund completed study. Study does not supply tools, evidence, consent or mastery in advance. Requests, registration, assessment checklists, missing-resource reports and learning grant no pleasure or satisfaction. A completed assay may qualify only for a personally applicable, genuinely verified information gain; a failed assay qualifies only if controls or observations actually establish a new bounded fact, not merely because it failed. If using the existing experience system, deduplicate by sample provenance, analyte, method and materially changed evidence; cap any eligible event at 0.2 short pleasure, at most once per 10 actual rounds, decaying to zero within 10 rounds, and at most 0.04 maintained satisfaction gain per eligible round with the existing 0.002 decay and existing account cap. Repeated equivalent readings cannot farm novelty rewards. These are event eligibility bounds, not permission to alter protected reward accounts, budgets, goals or permissions; if the existing protected interface cannot express them, issue no reward. No nutrition, health or physical-comfort benefit is granted.\",\"visualReview\":\"Emit observable assessment, step-start, material-transfer, timed-process, control-read, invalidation, cancellation and completed-result events only when those actions actually occur. Reusable visual metadata should include capability/mode, actor and target IDs, method reference, stage, progress, elapsed/deadline rounds, equipment/material IDs, location and status (requirements-missing, ready, active, paused, invalid, cancelled or result-available). Show real tools, sample preparation, containers and waste only when present. Any assay coloration or reader indication requires a modeled physical response and appropriate visibility; an assessment cannot display a completed test. Display result provenance, limits and invalid/inconclusive states alongside readings. No green safe-to-eat badge, treatment-success animation, imagined laboratory, toxin visualization, mastery effect or reward celebration for incomplete or failed work.\"}]}"}
